maria: Quick weekly health for Veridian (onboard cohort B). TL;DR: streaming p95/p99 generally better for long-context flows, but we saw one notable p99 spike on /chat that we should follow up on.

maria: Summary (last 7d):
- /chat (redwood-chat-4b-quant) streaming: p95 360ms, p99 1.15s
- /chat non-streaming: p95 520ms, p99 1.6s
- /summarize (redwood-2-xl) streaming: p95 420ms, p99 1.3s
- /rerank (rerank-lite) non-streaming: p95 95ms, p99 240ms
Error rate overall: 0.6% (streaming 0.8% vs non-stream 0.4%). Spend trend: +12% MoM driven by long-context interactive sessions.

dan: Noted on the /chat p99 — any rollout or token-length correlation?

maria: I pulled traces: big cluster at 03:12 UTC on 2025-12-09 from sessions with >2k tokens that missed prefix KV cache. Streaming mitigates perceived tail by returning partial tokens earlier, so non-stream shows larger p99 when cache misses happen.

sanjay: Also saw a bump in aborted streaming connections from one client subnet; ingress saw repeated TCP resets. Example error log: 
```
ERROR 03:12:18 connection reset by peer client=10.2.5.23 route=/chat session=abc123
```
That explains the streaming error-rate delta. I added a guard-rule to drop noisy clients.

lia: Good catch. Can CS schedule a 30m enablement with Veridian devs to cover reconnect/retry patterns, batching knobs, and prefix-cache hints? They've reported random timeouts when switching networks.

maria: Proposed slot Tue 10am PT. Action items: (1) dan to run a replay with long-context tuning and KV cache settings, (2) sanjay to roll the ingress reconnect patch to canary, (3) lia to run the enablement session and share client best-practices. Renewal risk: LOW but keep an eye — usage and spend rising; sent a note to account exec and updated CRM.

dan: I'll kick off the replay today and push a canary with smaller max-batch window + longer KV cache TTL to see immediate p99 impact :thumbsup:

ops-bot: telemetry export ready: https://console.redwood.dev/exports/veridian_weekly_1798880000.csv

lia: Ack, I'll send the invite and include a short checklist (client reconnect, backoff, telemetry flags). :white_check_mark:
